items.original_text: Among the precepts of the decalogue, we find the command: “Remember the sabbath day.” As the whole decalogue binds us, so does this commandment. (뒤) No man has a right to separate it from the rest, and claim exemption from its obligation.

items.original_text: (앞) No one thinks of the seventh year otherwise than as the year which follows six years of regular toil in the cultivation of the earth, and as regularly returning at equal intervals. The precise similarity of the command enjoining the observance of the seventh day sabbath, proves that the same method of interpretation must be applied to it. (뒤) If an obligation exists to observe Saturday, or Sunday, rather than any other day of the week, it cannot be found in this precept of the decalogue, and must be made out in some other way.
items.claim: 안식일에 대한 계명의 해석은 칠년을 기준으로 하는 해석 방법과 동일하게 적용되어야 한다.

items.original_text: (앞) A few years ago it was stated in some of our missionary intelligence, that a practical question of duty in the observance of the sabbath had arisen between some missionaries, who had met at their field of labor on the other side of the globe, having sailed to it by different routes, some by the eastern and others by the western. On comparing their computation, their sabbaths differed; and what was Saturday to one party was Sunday to the other. (뒤) If the seventh day of the week had been commanded, these missionaries could not have obeyed without becoming sabbath-breakers to each other; and if no higher wisdom than that of Moses, who was ignorant of the earth’s true form, had dictated the decalogue, its admirable adaptedness to the condition and circumstances of men, in every age and country, and under every meridian, would not have been secured.
items.claim: 일요일과 토요일을 기준으로 하는 휴일의 관행은 지구의 형태와 시간대에 따라 달라질 수 있다.

items.original_text: Another objection to the interpretation which supposes the seventh day of the week to be prescribed, may be seen in the fact that it makes Scripture dependent on tradition. (뒤) Had the observance of the new moon, or of the full moon, been commanded, the means of ascertaining the time intended would have been within the reach of every one; but had the Scripture commanded to observe the seventh day of the week, who could know the day required?
items.claim: 성경이 주일 제7일의 관행을 명령한다면 전통에 의존해야 한다는 사실은 이러한 해석에 대한 반대 의견이다.

items.original_text: (앞) Objection 1.—The doctrine of a special divine call to the ministry, savors of fanaticism. Christ distinguished His rule from that of earthly kings by the absence of coercion: “If my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight.”" So the spiritual rulers under Christ have no coercive power over the persons or property of those under their authority. items.original_text: (앞) Christ distinguished His rule from that of earthly kings by the absence of coercion: “If my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight.”" So the spiritual rulers under Christ have no coercive power over the persons or property of those under their authority. A well marked distinction between their authority and that which is exercised by civil rulers, is drawn in these words of Christ: “ Ye know that the princes of the gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them. (뒤) But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister; and whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant.” Another peculiarity of their rule is that they cannot govern at their own will.

items.original_text: (앞) To receive any one on a mere profession of words, without any effort to ascertain whether he understands and feels what he professes, is unfaithfulness to his interests, and the interests of religion. items.original_text: (앞) The health of the body requires exercise as well as food; so spiritual action is necessary for the health of the soul. Churches should exhort their members to be diligent in every good work, not only for the benefit of those around them, but also for their own spiritual improvement. (뒤) In this course of active service, their own souls will become strong in the Lord, and their personal experience will verify the words of Christ, “ It is more blessed to give than to receive.” The great work which demands the energy of all God’s people, is the spread of religion.
items.claim: 교회는 성도들이 주변 사람에게 이익이 되도록뿐만 아니라 자신들의 영적 성장에도 도움이 되도록 모든 좋은 일에 근면하게 노력하도록 권면해야 한다.
